transcript.title: Opening
transcript.text: Good morning Rushil Bhatia. Here is your daily news for Thursday, August 6. In today's briefing: top headlines, bhopal and madhya pradesh, business and markets, money, tax and personal finance, science and technology, development and policy, across india, around the world. Let's begin.

transcript.title: Top headlines
transcript.text: First, the stories leading the news this morning. 'May be jailed, but I'll return to Bangladesh this December,' says Sheikh Hasina. Sheikh Hasina declared she is not afraid of arrest upon her return to Bangladesh in December. She stated her return is for the nation's future and to set it on the right track. Dhaka reacted sharply, calling her an absconding convicted genocider and expressing regret over the event. Hasina described the July Uprising as a regime change operation orchestrated by a mastermind. Meta apologises for 'error in restricting PM's video'. Meta's CEO Mark Zuckerberg formally apologized to the Indian government over several operational missteps, including issues with paid content amplification. The acknowledgment of these errors comes as officials expressed concerns over the potential loss of safe harbor protection for the platform. As the government reassesses its child online safety regulations, Meta committed to implementing necessary corrective actions to address these concerns. Deal on Hormuz shipping route reached with Oman, says Iran. Iran and Oman have agreed on a proposed shipping route through the Strait of Hormuz. This agreement is a potential step toward reopening the critical waterway for energy supplies. A joint statement from Tehran and Muscat is currently in the final drafting stage. Sources indicate Iran would gain control over ships entering the Gulf via the strait. 'Respect senior players': Rahane warns Gambhir amid India's Test struggles. Rahane also pointed to the rapid transition in the Indian Test side. Within six months, India lost Ravichandran Ashwin, Rohit Sharma and Virat Kohli from the Test setup. Without naming anyone directly, he said a Test team needs more experienced players alongside youngsters. Ex-Ethiopian Air chief Tewolde Gebremariam becomes Air India CEO. Air India has appointed Tewolde Gebremariam as its new CEO and MD. He previously led Ethiopian Airlines for over 36 years, achieving significant growth. Gebremariam will succeed Campbell Wilson, who stabilized the airline initially. The Tata Group aims for profitable expansion and operational excellence under his leadership. Supreme Court acquits man after 22 years in jail for wrongful conviction. After enduring twenty-two long years of wrongful imprisonment, a man was finally acquitted by the Supreme Court. The injustice stemmed from the trial court's flawed evidence analysis, compounded by the High Court's refusal to entertain his delayed appeal. The Supreme Court emphasized how marginalized communities often find access to justice frustratingly elusive, shedding light on the pressing issues within the judicial system that disproportionately affect the underprivileged. Centre renews bid for delimitation bill as Rijiju reaches out to Rahul Gandhi. The government is pushing its delimitation legislation to increase Lok Sabha seats. This bill also proposes one-third reservation for women starting in 2029. Opposition leader Rahul Gandhi rejected the government's outreach for support. The government may reintroduce the Constitution amendment bill soon. Aussie snakes have 5 spine zones, necks just 7-12 vertebrae long. Recent studies reveal that snake spines are now categorized into five unique anatomical regions. Surprising findings indicate that snakes have a notably short neck, which reflects their ancestral lineage from lizards. Additionally, this research highlights a newly discovered middle thoracic region that has adapted for movement, enhancing their abilities to burrow, swim, and climb. Interestingly, snakes have evolved their skeletons structurally rather than simply after losing their limbs. Supreme Court urges states to decide on raising retirement age of judges by Sept 2. The Supreme Court urged states to decide on raising trial court judges' retirement age. This move aims to align their superannuation age with that of High Court judges. States were asked to make this decision by September 2, dismissing financial constraint arguments. The court stated that retaining experienced judges offers financial benefits to the government. Trai unveils draft service quality norms for network slicing. Indian telecom consumers may soon see network slicing come to life, as the telecom authority has released draft protocols for this groundbreaking technology. These anticipated regulations will enable different internet speeds tailored to various user segments, allowing telecom operators to set unique prices for services like 4G and 5G. This development follows appeals from prominent telecom service providers. Mob tries to set Shakib Hasan's house on fire for attending Hasina's presser. Hours after former Bangladesh cricket captain and ex-lawmaker Shakib Al Hasan attended a media interaction addressed by ousted prime minister Sheikh Hasina in New Delhi, unidentified people allegedly attacked his house in Bangladesh's Magura district, police said.

transcript.title: Bhopal and Madhya Pradesh
transcript.text: Now, news closer to home in Bhopal and across Madhya Pradesh. Narottam Mishra Visits 'Brother' Ashutosh Tiwari's Residence After Datia Debacle, Debunks Rumours On 'Differences'. Former minister Narottam Mishra visited BJP candidate Ashutosh Tiwari's home after the party's Datia by-election defeat, dismissing rumours of differences between them. Over 5,000 MP Government School Teachers Still Attached To Offices Despite Recall Orders. More than 5,000 government school teachers in Madhya Pradesh remain attached to administrative offices despite repeated recall orders, worsening teacher shortages in schools. Fake Crime Branch, Legal Know-How: Bhopal Woman's Extortion Gang Busted. BRICS meets tribal art and folk performances in Bhopal. MP High Court Extends Interim Protection To Viral Kumbh Girl And Husband. The Indore Bench of the Madhya Pradesh High Court has extended interim protection from coercive action to the viral Kumbh Mela girl and her husband in a case involving disputed birth records and their interfaith marriage. Hundreds of trees felled for saplings: Bhopal plantation drive sparks outrage. IIM Indore Launches Business Accelerator Programme for SC/ST Entrepreneurs. IIM Indore Incubation Foundation has launched the Business Accelerator Programme under the National SC-ST Hub to support SC/ST entrepreneurs with training, mentorship and market access. India to push repatriation of stolen, smuggled idols at BRICS culture group meeting in Bhopal. How A Madhya Pradesh Village Became 'Mini Holland' With Modern Flower Farming. TOI report helps elderly unmask 'fake' physio. Government school teacher shows up 'drunk', probe ordered. Toddler abducted from Gwalior rly station rescued. 2 abduct and gang-rape 13-year-old tribal girl. Weak monsoon leaves 25 dists rain deficient. 11 firms eye Ujjain IT Park, seek 1.26 lakh sq ft. CM proposes SHG-MSME link for rural welfare. Over 40 percent of MP districts have less than 70 percent potable tap water coverage. Farmers demand full moong procurement at MSP in Madhya Pradesh.

transcript.title: Business and markets
transcript.text: Moving to business, the economy and the markets. Gold Holds Gain as Progress on Hormuz Deal Lowers Rate-Hike Odds. Gold held a sharp gain as signs of progress in reopening the Strait of Hormuz eased energy-led pressure on the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates. Oil Holds Three-Day Drop as Iran, Oman Reach Hormuz Agreement. Oil held losses as Iran said it reached an agreement with Oman on a proposed shipping route through the Strait of Hormuz, raising the prospect of some energy flows resuming through the critical waterway. Tech Trade May See Bigger Retail Influence After July Rout, JPMorgan Says. The technology trade may be poised to become even more dependent on retail investors and more volatile after a rough July, according to an assessment of preliminary data on technology, media and telecommunications equity sector hedge funds from JPMorgan Chase and Co. Hedge Funds Take Big Hit in July After Bruising AI Selloff. A spate of well-known hedge funds reported steep losses in July as AI shares tumbled, most notably forcing the highly leveraged Situational Awareness to sell most of its stock portfolio at a deep discount to Ken Griffin's Citadel. Gold Jumps Most Since February on Hormuz, Technical Breakout. Gold jumped the most since February as prospects for a deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz reduced expectations for Federal Reserve rate hikes, while a break above a key technical resistance level fueled additional buying. Yen firms after landmark intervention, dollar near lows on optimism over Iran talks. GLOBAL-FOREX:Yen firms after landmark intervention, dollar near lows on optimism over Iran talks Treasury yields fall as oil dips on Strait of Hormuz hopes. USA-BONDS/ (UPDATE 1):TREASURIES UPI's rupees 2,000 twist: Are you affected when you pay?. UPI MDR: Government proposes changes to the Payment and Settlement Systems Act. LIC share sale ends with partial retail subscription. India's $3.3 billion stake sale in LIC saw lower retail demand, with bids covering only 69 percent of shares reserved for individuals, contrasting with strong institutional interest. Gold, silver prices today: Comex gold jumps $173, silver hits $63 as US-Iran peace hopes lift sentiment. Gold and silver prices rose for a second session due to optimism over US-Iran diplomatic negotiations, easing inflation concerns. Comex gold reached $4,325 while silver climbed to $63. A weaker US dollar also supported demand for these precious metals. China's drone power play in tech duel with US. China has announced a fresh set of economic countermeasures against the US, including export controls on drones and sanctions on six American entities, in response to recent US restrictions on Chinese firms and products. 'CAS isn't a bad idea, but...': Why Nithin Kamath says India's closing auction is exposing deeper market cracks. Nithin Kamath, CEO of Zerodha, commented on BSE and NSE's new Closing Auction Session (CAS), noting that while it's a good idea, recent price swings reveal deeper issues in India's markets, particularly the limited ability for arbitrage due to a lack of liquidity and varied market participants. US shuts the door on thousands of Indian students. US student visas issued to Indian nationals fell 62 percent during the peak admission season in 2025, according to an analysis by the Center for Immigration Studies, as the Trump administration tightened F-1 visa screening and introduced stricter immigration measures for international students. SpaceX's lockup expiry tomorrow could trigger record insider selling: 'We're in uncharted waters'. SpaceX faces a significant test as its IPO lockup period expires, allowing insiders to sell shares for the first time. Zuckerberg says sorry to India over CSAM, deepfakes. Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg has apologised to the Indian government over child sexual abuse material, deepfake content and operational errors on the company's platforms, according to government sources. Up over 500 percent in 2026! This small-cap telecom stock to be in focus on Thursday after $210 million international order. Sterlite Technologies secured a $210 million international order for optical fibre cables, set for a three-year execution. This follows a major domestic supply agreement and recent fundraising efforts to reduce debt, enhancing the company's strong financial position amid significant stock growth. Ambanis give Kim's Skims an India fit. Reliance Brands will bring Kim Kardashian's SKIMS to India soon. Why is Wall Street ignoring the controversy surrounding Palantir? Expert says 'It's not a referendum on ethics'. Palantir's substantial growth, primarily driven by commercial revenue rather than government contracts, challenges perceptions of its ethical standing. Expert notes the software sits outside typical ESG exclusions Hasina to return to Dhaka despite risks. She reiterated her intention to return to Dhaka towards this year-end and claimed that her objective was not power but to help restore democracy and development. SpaceX shares plunge 13 percent as AI spending overshadows earnings beat; down over 50 percent from post-listing peak. SpaceX shares dropped 13 percent to $109.21, despite exceeding revenue expectations. Investors focused on increased AI spending, totaling $18.4 billion, significantly impacting cash flow. The AI segment generated $2.6 billion but faced a $1.26 billion loss. SPAC's stock is now down 40 percent since its IPO. Air India's new CEO steered Africa's biggest airline. Air India has appointed Tewolde Gebremariam as its new Chief Executive Officer. Wall Street advances on Iran deal hopes, SpaceX and AMD dip. As of 10:45 a.m. Eastern Time, the S and P 500 climbed 0.4 percent , the Dow Jones Industrial Average added 1.1 percent , and the Nasdaq Composite rose 0.1 percent . Melania Trump made $10.7M from Amazon docu. Melania Trump earned $10.71 million from the Amazon MGM documentary about her, despite the film bringing in just $16 million at the box office against its reported $75 million production and promotional cost. PB Fintech Q1 Results: Net profit nearly doubles to rupees 163 crore; revenue climbs 40 percent. PB Fintech reported a Q1FY27 net profit of rupees 163 crore, a 92 percent increase from last year, with revenue rising 40 percent YoY to rupees 1,888 crore. However, both profit and revenue declined sequentially from the previous quarter. Trump claims Iran clarity may come in 48 hours. President Trump stated significant progress has been made in discussions with Iran. Navin Fluorine Q1 Results: Net profit more than doubles to rupees 243 crore as margins expand; revenue rises 44 percent. Navin Fluorine International reported a consolidated net profit of rupees 243.31 crore for the June quarter, a 108 percent YoY increase. Revenue from operations rose to rupees 1,045.08 crore, up 44.1 percent YoY, driven by strong business momentum. US removes sanctions from 3 IRGC-linked entities. The US Treasury Department has removed Fly Baghdad and two aircraft from its sanctions list.

transcript.title: Money, tax and personal finance
transcript.text: Now to your money — taxes, savings and personal finance. Nagpur woman loses rupees 6.93 lakh in online scam, files complaint against bank, wins back money with 9 percent interest and additional rupees 35000. A Nagpur woman who lost rupees 6.93 lakh in a FedEx parcel scam won a consumer court case against ICICI Bank. The commission ordered the bank to refund the remaining amount with 9 percent interest and pay rupees 35,000 as compensation. Here's how she won the case. Radhika Gupta says REITs are not fixed-income investments, but differ from equities: Here's what another expert thinks. REITs are often mistaken for fixed-income products due to their regular payouts, but they carry equity-like risks. Their returns depend on rental income, occupancy and property cycles, making them a diversification tool rather than a substitute for debt investments. 8th Pay Commission salary calculator: How Level 10 employees can get rupees 25 lakh extra gross salary in 10 years at 6 percent annual increment rate. 8th Pay Commission latest news: Employee groups are urging the 8th Pay Commission to raise annual increments significantly. They suggest increasing the rate from three percent to at least five percent. Some organizations propose an increment of six percent annually for employees. Other federations are advocating for a seven percent annual increment rate. Selling US-listed shares after returning to India? Here's how they are taxed. The Indian tax law does not provide any special exemption or relief for losses or gains arising solely due to depreciation of the Indian rupee against the foreign currency during the investment period. UPI payments above rupees 2000 to attract MDR after debit, credit cards? Here's what users need to know about the proposal. While there has been no official word from the government on this yet, it is learnt that the Centre could allow a levy of 0.25 percent to 0.4 percent as merchant discount rate (MDR) charges on UPI payments above rupees 2000. So, does this mean that the proposal will directly impact you? First understand what MDR is. Will UPI payments remain free forever? Bernstein says consumers likely to stay unaffected; 30-40 bps MDR possible. UPI users may remain unaffected even if Merchant Discount Rate is introduced, according to Bernstein. The brokerage expects large merchants to bear a 30-40 bps fee, while small merchants and low-value transactions may remain exempt. RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra says it is too early to comment. Best FD interest rates in India: Check fixed deposit returns of DCB Bank, RBL Bank, YES Bank and more. Interest rates on fixed deposits differ significantly among banks. Investors should consider factors such as bank reputation and financial goals when choosing deposit options with varying maturities. Sovereign Gold Bond investor alert: Check August 2026 SGB premature redemption calendar and schedule. For those invested in Sovereign Gold Bonds, early redemption for select tranches is possible from August 2026. This opportunity arises five years post-issue. Investors should ensure they submit their redemption applications within the stipulated timelines, as the redemption value will reflect gold prices from the previous three working days. Missing the submission period could mean a denial of the premature redemption option. ITR-6 Excel utility for AY 2026-27 released: Eligibility, due dates, key documents explained. The Income Tax Department has released the Excel utility for ITR-6 for AY 2026-27. The utility is now available on the e-Filing portal. The form is applicable to companies that are not claiming exemption under Section 11 of the Income Tax Act. PPF rules for NRIs: Can non-resident Indians open PPF account in India?. A Public Provident Fund (PPF) is a long-term, small savings scheme offered by the government of India. The PPF offers an attractive interest rate and tax benefits under the Old Tax Regime. The PPF interest rate is 7.1 percent for this quarter. Interest earned is tax-free under the Income Tax Act 2025. Boost your savings on autopilot: How cash optimisation apps put your surplus money to work. Cash optimisation apps allow you to park unused money in liquid mutual funds or fixed deposits, delivering higher yields than standard savings accounts. EPFO may launch E-PRAAPTI by August-end: How the new portal can help you trace old or inactive PF accounts. The EPFO is expected to launch E-PRAAPTI by the end of August to help members recover money lying in old or inactive PF accounts. The Aadhaar-based portal aims to simplify account tracing, reduce paperwork, enable UAN linking, and make claims faster through a digital process. RBI holds repo rate at 5.25 percent : 5 assumptions about EMIs, FD rates and inflation salaried employees shouldn't make. The RBI has kept the repo rate unchanged at 5.25 percent while raising its FY27 growth forecast and trimming its inflation estimate. Here's why salaried employees shouldn't expect lower EMIs, cheaper loans or sharply lower FD rates just yet. No insurance, no fuel? Supreme Court proposes pilot project, extends tenure of third party insurance cover for new vehicles. The Supreme Court has proposed new measures to address widespread non-compliance with mandatory motor insurance laws. Automatic e-challans and a potential 'no insurance, no fuel' system are being considered. The court also extended mandatory third-party insurance periods for new vehicles. Citizens will soon be able to verify vehicle insurance status through a pilot project. Does Section 54F tax exemption apply if LTCG is used to buy property from spouse? Here's what the ITAT ruling says. The Mumbai ITAT ruled that a genuine property purchase from a spouse cannot be denied Section 54F tax exemption merely because it results in tax savings. The tribunal found no evidence of tax avoidance and allowed a taxpayer's rupees 6.92 crore exemption claim after the tax department challenged it. 8th Pay Commission schedules Jaipur meetings with employee and pensioner bodies; key dates, deadline to apply. 8th Pay Commission: The 8th Pay Commission will hold meetings in Jaipur. These discussions involve central government employees and their representative bodies. Similar meetings have been scheduled for New Delhi, Chandigarh, Chennai, and Puducherry. Stakeholders must submit requests for appointments through a specific online portal. RBI policy remains unchanged , but is this the right time to revisit and strengthen your emergency fund strategy?. The RBI held the policy repo rate at 5.25 percent , maintaining a cautious stance amid uncertainties. Governor Malhotra noted the uncertain growth outlook due to various factors. Here's what retail investors should do in such times. 7 percent savings account interest rate: This bank hikes rates across balances; new rates applicable from August 1, 2026. Savings account interest rate: Unity Small Finance Bank has recently announced a new interest rate of 7 percent on savings accounts, with even higher returns for amounts surpassing five lakh rupees. In addition, senior citizens can benefit from an attractive 8.50 percent interest on a special 501-day fixed deposit. Other small finance banks are also rolling out competitive rates. These changes took effect on August 1, 2026. Beyond 31 July: Taxpayer's guide to every ITR deadline. While business and professional filers of ITR-3 and ITR-4 get more time, even those who missed the 31 July deadline get a chance to file a belated ITR, though with a penalty. New rupees 25,000 EPF wage ceiling coming? Know what the proposal could mean for your PF contributions and pension. According to a Moneycontrol report, the Department of Expenditure under the Ministry of Finance has approved a proposal to raise the EPF wage ceiling from rupees 15,000 to rupees 25,000. Changes in EBLR and MCLR framework, interest rate charging mechanism and how reset dates are decided- RBI proposal. RBI MPC policy: The Reserve Bank of India plans to simplify loan interest rate rules for all regulated entities. This initiative aims to harmonize guidelines and address operational aspects of current lending rate benchmarks. The proposed changes will standardize market practices concerning interest charging and benchmark reset dates. These measures intend to improve transparency and strengthen monetary policy transmission across the system. Does paying off a loan early improve your credit score? Here's what experts say. Early loan repayment reduces interest costs but may not immediately improve credit scores. Experts explain how timely payments, credit utilisation, debt management and responsible borrowing habits play a bigger role in building a strong credit profile. Wife paid husband rupees 7.5 crore after selling her shares and bought his Mumbai property, filed ITR claiming 54F tax exemption, got tax notice; she fought and won the case in ITAT Mumbai. Wife got tax notice as she claimed Section 54F tax exemption by purchasing her husband's own Mumbai property for rupees 7.5 crore; ITAT Mumbai rules that a property transaction between spouses does not become sham merely because they are related. Know how she won the case in ITAT Mumbai. What India's investors can learn from South Korea's market meltdown. South Korea's AI-driven stock market boom turned into a sharp rout within weeks. Here's what Indian investors can learn about leverage, passive investing, diversification and FOMO. RBI MPC: Home loan borrowers can breathe a sigh of relief, but how long their good days will last?. RBI repo rate: The Reserve Bank of India has maintained its repo rate at 5.25 percent , providing ongoing relief for home loan borrowers.
